text: What if everyone on Earth woke up speaking the same language?
Your language teacher walks into class. Nobody needs her anymore. She takes the day off.
Airports, hotels, menus. Suddenly, tourists understand everything. Including what the waiter says about them.
Every comment section on the planet understands each other. The internet has never been louder.
You finally understand every song you ever sang along to. Some of them are terrible.
Your grandma video calls a family in Brazil. They talk for three hours about recipes.
Everyone understands each other perfectly. And they still don't agree on anything.
Who would you talk to first? Tell me in the comments.
